concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-reconciliation-use-cases-first-year-focus-platform-level-reporting]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace first-year guide to monthly, transaction, user and invoice reporting methods, with liable-account and report-grain joins, blended-pricing scope and sample-formula limits.
warnings: Monthly liable-account payout sum minus invoice costs is described only as an initial indicator; initiated payout timing differs from bank arrival and costs, and nontransactional expenses affect full profitability.
Transaction-level method is explicitly blended-pricing only; Balance Platform Accounting omits Processing Fees, and user effective-rate denominator is incomplete in the text.
Grouped Visa template's commission/fee figures do not subtract to its profit; per-location/user suggested cost allowance has malformed currency text and is not a validated fee rate.
